# Communications Hub — what is finished and what is waiting

<!-- GENERATED by tests/matrix/databaseBlocked.test.mjs. Edit the matrix there, not this file. -->

18 features. 14 are complete and unblocked today. 4 need something outside this repository, named in their own row rather than summarised here — a provider credential only the owner can read, a provider-side endpoint, or a real call to a real person. Nothing is waiting on code.

No row below is waiting on code that has not been written.

## The two migrations, applied

- `supabase/migrations/20260912110000_communications_hub.sql`
- `supabase/migrations/20260912110500_communications_functions.sql`

They create 12 tables: `comm_account_trust`, `comm_agent_versions`, `comm_agents`, `comm_channel_accounts`, `comm_conversations`, `comm_extractions`, `comm_messages`, `comm_provider_routes`, `comm_risk_assessments`, `comm_talk_sessions`, `comm_webhook_events`, `comm_whatsapp_templates`.

Both are live in production, verified on 2026-09-14 against the tables, the functions and the migration ledger. Nothing in this document is waiting on a schema decision.
